tasks.title: Scaffold mocker project
tasks.description: Create Mocker/Mocker.csproj and Mocker/Program.cs for a QaaS mocker. Refer to QaaS.Mocker and QaaS.Common.Processors. Program.cs has one line: QaaS.Mocker.Bootstrap.New(args).Run(); Make sure all NuGet configurations and package tags are fully valid and non-empty.

tasks.title: Author mocker YAML and verify via curl
tasks.description: Author Mocker/svc.mocker.yaml matching the verified golden shape. Top-level keys: DataSources, Stubs, Servers. Define appropriate processors, stubs, and endpoints listening on port 8110.

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','svc.mocker.yaml' -PassThru; $ok = $false; foreach ($i in 1..40) { try { (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', 8110)).Close(); (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', 8111)).Close(); $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep 2 } }; if (-not $ok) { Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force; exit 9 }; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0

acceptanceCriteria: Live boot and port check succeeded

goalOneSentence: Build and verify mocker dual-port-servers exposing services on port 8110.
portContract: This sprint's mocker(s) MUST listen on HTTP port 8110. Every runner Transaction MUST target http://127.0.0.1:8110 (set the mocker server Port: 8110 and the runner BaseAddress/Port to 8110). Do NOT use the 8080 default from Fact Base examples - use 8110 exactly, or the live end-to-end run cannot connect. This sprint also requires additional ports: 8110, 8111 - bind every server exactly as the task specifies.
